description:
Hi everyone! We are three students from a Vocational College (KV), currently working on a space-themed interactive storytelling game inspired by NASA's Mars exploration missions.

Our project explores the journeys of NASA's Mars rovers, Spirit and Opportunity, through engaging visual novel-style experience.

As three young creators, we aim to combine storytelling, creativity, and technology to bring the mysteries of Mars to everyone.

Three students, one project, and a journey beyond Earth! 🚀
summary:
Our project is an interactive visual storytelling website developed by three students from a Vocational College (KV) for the 2025 NASA Space Apps Challenge. Using Canva, we created a website that allows players to explore the journeys of NASA's Mars rovers, Spirit and Opportunity, through interactive buttons, visuals, and storytelling.

The project transforms NASA's scientific discoveries and mission history into an engaging experience. Rather than simply reading facts, visitors can follow the rovers' journeys, discover their achievements, and learn about Mars exploration through an interactive story.

This project is important because it makes space science more accessible and enjoyable, encourages curiosity about the universe, and demonstrates how creative storytelling can be used to share scientific knowledge.
details:
IMPORTANT: VIEWING REQUIREMENTS

This interactive storytelling website is designed exclusively for laptops and tablets in landscape mode. For the best experience, please access the website using one of these devices.

Project Overview

Our project is an interactive visual storytelling website that introduces visitors to the journeys of NASA's Mars rovers, Spirit and Opportunity. Developed by three students from a Vocational College (KV), the website uses a visual novel-inspired format to turn real space exploration missions into an engaging story.

How It Works

Visitors navigate through the website by clicking interactive buttons to move between scenes, follow the rovers' journeys, and discover important events and scientific findings. Each section presents short narrations, visuals, and information based on NASA's mission data.

Benefits and Intended Impact

Our goal is to make learning about Mars exploration more interesting and accessible. We hope to encourage curiosity about space, inspire young learners, and help visitors appreciate the achievements of robotic space exploration.

Tools and Software

We used Canva to design and develop the website, including its visual layouts, graphics, storytelling elements, and interactive navigation. We also referred to NASA's official resources and mission data to support the accuracy of the information presented.

Creativity and Team Considerations

Our creative approach combines storytelling with interactive website elements. Instead of presenting information like a traditional slideshow, we allow visitors to experience the missions through a story-driven journey.

As a team of three, we considered scientific accuracy, screen orientation, visual presentation, navigation, and readability to maintain the intended storytelling experience.
dataRefs: Celebrating Spirit & Opportunity’s 20th Anniversary Landing on Mars
